# Daily Briefing — 28 September 2026

Yesterday was a solid effort — 20.1km in 124 minutes at an average 154bpm shows good aerobic work, and burning 4,035 kcal with 26,966 steps is a big day. The real concern though is 3.6 hours of sleep. That's not enough recovery for that training load, full stop.

Your HRV at 98ms sits just below your 99–118ms baseline, and combined with the sleep deficit, your body is telling you it's running behind on recovery. Don't ignore that. Today, dial intensity back — keep any session easy, zone 2 only, or consider a full rest day. Pushing hard today risks compounding the fatigue.

Priority number one today is sleep tonight — genuinely non-negotiable after yesterday. Hit your 175g protein target to support muscle repair, and bump fluids; a 4,000+ kcal burn day leaves you dehydrated. Recover well and you'll bank that fitness properly. 💪
